# Bust Candidates

**Summary.** In our 9-cat room, the biggest bust risks are early-round players that the market prices off Yahoo or ESPN ranks or off last season's prices. Examples are Cade Cunningham, Tyrese Maxey, Tyrese Haliburton, Jalen Johnson, Donovan Mitchell and Jalen Brunson. A bust label is only about price, so every player below comes with the price at which he becomes a fine buy. Write down each cap before the draft and let other managers pay more.

## A bust label is a price label

Calling a player a bust does not mean you never draft him. It means the market values him wrongly at his current price. Whether to fade him depends on where he goes, not on liking or disliking him. So every player line in this article ends with the price at which he becomes fine to buy. Below that price, buy him. Above it, let someone else pay. ([09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=73), [09-29](https://youtu.be/NmdNvAz08oE?t=1586), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1278))

A bust label means nothing until you know which format it comes from. Ours is 9-cat H2H, and turnovers count. Many bust calls here are about ESPN ranks. ESPN has Jalen Duren at 23, Pascal Siakam at 24 and Mikal Bridges at 26, while Yahoo and the category experts have them much lower. In our room, the danger is managers who anchor on ESPN ranks. Do not follow their bids. ([08-30](https://youtu.be/Alwse2uXzD4?t=2154), [Jalen Duren](../profiles/players/jalen-duren.md), [Pascal Siakam](../profiles/players/pascal-siakam.md), [Mikal Bridges](../profiles/players/mikal-bridges.md))

Last season's prices in our league are the other trap. Anthony Davis, Devin Booker, Stephen Curry, James Harden and Karl-Anthony Towns all sold for far more last year than the experts now pay. If the room opens near last year's numbers, drop out early. Your money is better spent where the price fits the projection. ([Anthony Davis](../profiles/players/anthony-davis.md), [Devin Booker](../profiles/players/devin-booker.md), [Stephen Curry](../profiles/players/stephen-curry.md), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Karl-Anthony Towns](../profiles/players/karl-anthony-towns.md))

## How to test a price in the room

Play the prediction game. Project a realistic stat line, then ask whether it justifies the price. Tyrese Maxey is the clearest case. Projections have his shot attempts near 19 per game, down from 21.4. A top-10 price pays for last season's line, not this one. Experts bid in the low 40s. ([09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1057), [Tyrese Maxey](../profiles/players/tyrese-maxey.md))

A projection is a median outcome. When two players project the same, take the one with the wider range. Veterans like Harrison Barnes or Tobias Harris have no realistic path above their projection. That is why Harris is only a 1 to 2 USD pick at the end of the draft. ([10-02](https://youtu.be/ZYllcj4o6_A?t=994), [Tobias Harris](../profiles/players/tobias-harris.md))

Before 2026-10-18, write a hard cap next to each name on this list and stop bidding there. Example: Cade Cunningham is a good fit for punt TO, but experts cap him at 45 USD. If the room goes to 55 USD or more, let him go. Use the saved money on a player whose price is below his projection. ([Cade Cunningham](../profiles/players/cade-cunningham.md), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1278))

## Role loss and crowded usage

When a team adds high-usage players, the existing star loses usage and assist upside, even if his minutes stay the same. A scorer next to other ball-dominant players sees his on-ball role shrink. Donovan Mitchell now has Harden there full time. Pascal Siakam gets Haliburton back. Maxey and VJ Edgecombe share the ball with Brown, LeBron and Embiid. Price each of them below last season's role. ([09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=817), [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=580), [Donovan Mitchell](../profiles/players/donovan-mitchell.md), [Pascal Siakam](../profiles/players/pascal-siakam.md), [Tyrese Maxey](../profiles/players/tyrese-maxey.md), [VJ Edgecombe](../profiles/players/vj-edgecombe.md))

Be wary when a player's value came from teammates being absent. When those teammates return, his production drops. Desmond Bane's last two seasons got a boost from teammate absences. Jamal Murray's usage is in question now that Denver is healthy and DeRozan has arrived. Randle cuts Michael Porter Jr.'s usage. Andrew Nembhard is a Haliburton handcuff, so his value depends on Haliburton missing time. ([09-10](https://youtu.be/W-R1dzem32s?t=1494), [Desmond Bane](../profiles/players/desmond-bane.md), [Jamal Murray](../profiles/players/jamal-murray.md), [Michael Porter Jr.](../profiles/players/michael-porter.md), [Andrew Nembhard](../profiles/players/andrew-nembhard.md))

In the first weeks, check the role numbers. For Jalen Johnson, check assists, steals and FG% with McCollum on the floor. For Devin Booker, check whether he or Jalen Green runs the offense. For Maxey, shot attempts near 19 and minutes under 38 confirm the expected drop. ([Jalen Johnson](../profiles/players/jalen-johnson.md), [Devin Booker](../profiles/players/devin-booker.md), [Tyrese Maxey](../profiles/players/tyrese-maxey.md))

## Shooting and rate regression

When many players have career years at once, expect some to regress, often together. Flagged rate spikes:
- Nickeil Alexander-Walker: about 95% FT late last season, expected back toward about 81%.
- Ayo Dosunmu: 3P% rose from 33 to 44 and FT% from 78 to 88.
- Murray: expected to fall from 42-43% to about 40-41% from three.
- Kon Knueppel: rookie efficiency should drop without LaMelo Ball.
- Walker Kessler: his threes and steals came from a five-game sample.
- Jakob Poeltl: 70% FG on low volume.
- Keegan Murray: experts doubt his 1.6 blocks per game hold. ([08-23](https://youtu.be/hm5-fiCa5S4?t=226), [Nickeil Alexander-Walker](../profiles/players/nickeil-alexander-walker.md), [Ayo Dosunmu](../profiles/players/ayo-dosunmu.md), [Jamal Murray](../profiles/players/jamal-murray.md), [Kon Knueppel](../profiles/players/kon-knueppel.md), [Walker Kessler](../profiles/players/walker-kessler.md), [Jakob Poeltl](../profiles/players/jakob-poeltl.md), [Keegan Murray](../profiles/players/keegan-murray.md))

Regression only makes a bust when the price assumes the spike. Alexander-Walker should regress, but his market cost is low, so 12 to 18 USD is still a good price. Mitchell's career-best two-point shooting, late-season FT% and steals are expected to come down. That makes ESPN's 58 USD value too high, and he is fine in the low-to-mid 30s. FG% and FT% are team ratios, so a drop from a high-volume shooter hurts more than one from a low-volume player. ([Nickeil Alexander-Walker](../profiles/players/nickeil-alexander-walker.md), [Donovan Mitchell](../profiles/players/donovan-mitchell.md), [09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=73))

## Age, games played and our playoff weeks

A player who has been in the league a long time and is turning 29 is probably who he is, not a breakout. For older stars, the risk is mostly games and minutes, not the per-game line:
- Kevin Durant (37): media day reports point to fewer minutes, and his value changes materially near 33 minutes.
- Stephen Curry (38): the knee and 15 back-to-backs.
- Anthony Davis: sites project 58 to 61 games.
- Kawhi Leonard: 60 to 65 expected games and likely load management. ([07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=837), [Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md), [Stephen Curry](../profiles/players/stephen-curry.md), [Anthony Davis](../profiles/players/anthony-davis.md), [Kawhi Leonard](../profiles/players/kawhi-leonard.md))

Our playoffs are weeks 19 to 21, ending 2027-03-28, so check playoff schedules before you pay:
- Philadelphia (Maxey, LeBron) and Toronto (Leonard) each have three back-to-backs in those weeks.
- Cleveland (Mitchell, Harden) has a two-game finals week.
- Haliburton gets only 10 games.
- Houston (Durant) plays only 10 games.
This is a reason to stop a bid a few dollars early, not to skip the player. ([LeBron James](../profiles/players/lebron-james.md), [Tyrese Maxey](../profiles/players/tyrese-maxey.md), [Kawhi Leonard](../profiles/players/kawhi-leonard.md), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Tyrese Haliburton](../profiles/players/tyrese-haliburton.md), [Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md))

Our 4 IL slots make injured veterans cheap to hold. Brandon Ingram is a fair late stash at a few dollars while he recovers from the Achilles injury. Jimmy Butler is at most a 1 USD final pick to stash on IL. Do not pay last season's prices for either one. ([Brandon Ingram](../profiles/players/brandon-ingram.md), [Jimmy Butler III](../profiles/players/jimmy-butler.md))

## Where the experts disagree

The experts split on De'Aaron Fox. Some call his ESPN ADP around 42 too high. Others say he is undervalued. The market has already fallen hard, and under about 13 USD both sides can live with him. The open questions are whether his burst is back after the ankle sprain and how many minutes Dylan Harper takes. ([De'Aaron Fox](../profiles/players/deaaron-fox.md))

The sites also disagree with each other, and the experts usually side with one of them. ESPN ranks Giannis 20th with a 40 USD value, but experts call that wrong and expect him to cost 58 to 62 USD. On Harden and Stephon Castle, the two sites' prices point in opposite directions. For each player, use the expert price, not either site's rank. ([Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Stephon Castle](../profiles/players/stephon-castle.md))
